The control thermocouple and the tube pressure gauge are installed and reporting.

evidence.observation: Tube pressure was 3.037 Torr at growth setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen progressively through 3.150, 3.184, 3.303 and 3.396 to 3.481 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Temperature is 749.8 °C and Ar flow is 99.6 sccm, both tracking their setpoints; neither explains the sustained pressure rise.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; atmosphere composition cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure verification and checks of tube sealing and exhaust conductance are needed to distinguish leakage, exhaust restriction or gauge error. Required exhaust O2 measurement is unavailable. No sample characterization has been provided.
